plot: On a rainy morning in the garden Zeek ties grumpy Old Hissy to a rocket to reach the moon with Pim as pilot; the test launch flops because Hissy holds back, Crispy learns the kettle secretly dreams of travelling, Hissy becomes the pilot and loops into the birdbath begging for more, and the rocket's photo shows something on the roof waving back.

script.title: Can Zeek's Kettle Rocket Reach the Moon

beats.say: SSSSTOP poking my spout! I am BOILING!
Perfect! Keep boiling! Hotter! That steam is rocket fuel!
Morning in the garden, after the rain. The pale moon still hangs over the fence, and Zeek wants to touch it.
Zeek. Explain to me, slowly, why there is a kettle tied to a rocket.
Simple science. Hissy makes steam. Steam pushes. The rocket goes up. I land on the moon by lunch.
And who exactly is sitting inside the rocket?
You, Pim. You are the lightest. Also the most aerodynamic bean I have ever met.
I'm a BEAN! Beans don't fly! Beans stay in the dirt, safely, forever and ever!
I packed you a snack, sweetie. Moon cheese. That's a joke. It's regular cheese.
Nobody asked ME. Nobody EVER asks the kettle.
Then I will ask. Old Hissy. Nobody has asked you in years. What do you want?
What I want is SILENCE! And for that triangle to stop tickling my handle!
Crispy, please. You are ruining my countdown.
You are ruining a kettle. Look at him. He is shaking.
Test launch number one. Everybody stands back. Pim stands very, very far back.
It went up four centimeters and fell over. That's not space, Zeek. That's a hop.
My calculations say Hissy is holding back. He is boiling at half power. On purpose.
Why are you holding back, old one?
Because... if the rocket flies... it flies away. Without me.
Forty years I whistle on a stove. Every whistle says the same thing. Take me somewhere. Nobody listens.
Wait. The grumpy screaming kettle... just wants to travel?
Everyone who screams is trying to say something.
Then the math changes. Zero point six kilos of bean... or one point four kilos of kettle.
Zeek. Speak normal. Use small words, like a cookie would.
Hissy rides the rocket! He is the fuel AND the pilot!
Me? The PILOT? ...Do I get a hat?
I'll ice one for you. Pink, with little stars. Very official.
And I stay on the ground? Best plan ever! Zeek, you are a genius!
Three... two... one... GO, HISSY, GO!
WHEEEEEEE! SSSSSSS!
Old Hissy soars over the fence, over the tomatoes, around the apple tree... and straight down into the birdbath.
Is he okay? Is he broken? Is he wet? He's definitely wet.
Look at his face. That is the happiest kettle I have ever seen. He's whistling a song!
Zeek, your rocket didn't reach the moon. But it reached a birdbath. That's progress.
AGAIN! I want to go AGAIN! Higher! Tomorrow, the moon!
A kettle with a dream. Dangerous. Tomorrow he will want to visit the sun.
The rocket camera took one photo from the very top. Let me see...
Bup. Come here. Look at the roof of the house.
That's just the chimney. Chimneys are normal.
Chimneys do not wave, Bup. And they do not have three glowing eyes either.
Something on the roof is WAVING at us? Nope. Fainting. Goodbye, everyone.

long.title: Can Zeek's Kettle Rocket Reach the Moon? 🚀
